newsitem.title: USA: Grubb & Ellis' Young to become chairman.
newsitem.headline: Grubb & Ellis' Young to become chairman.

text.p: Grubb & Ellis Co said on Monday president and chief executive officer Neil Young will assume the chairmanship on April 15 when investor Joe Hanauer relinquishes the title.
Hanauer will remain on the Grubb & Ellis board of directors and will continue to serve on its executive committee.

Hanauer joined Grubb & Ellis as chairman in January 1993 when he led the restructuring of the commercial real estate company. He also served as interim CEO from July 1994 to December 1995 while the company accelerated its reorganization.
Young joined the company in 1983 as an industrial broker.
